_doc.zh: 皮神经分布区图定义。各分布区的种子取自其神经部件的中心线中距皮肤不超过 maxDepthMm 的部分（“nerve” 种子，basis 为 nerve-geometry），和/或体表标志曲线（“curve” 种子；basis 为 landmark-rule 时仅有此类种子）。标签自全部种子沿皮肤表面按测地距离扩散，左右两侧分别计算。segments 为教科书所载的脊髓节段来源及其出处；via 为按部件名称列出的、通向神经丛的上级神经链。
_doc.en: Cutaneous nerve territory map definition. A territory is seeded from the centrelines of its nerve parts where they run within maxDepthMm of the skin ('nerve' seeds, basis nerve-geometry) and/or from landmark curves ('curve' seeds; the only seeds when basis is landmark-rule). Labels spread from all seeds by geodesic distance on the skin, each side separately. 'segments' are textbook root values with their source; 'via' is the parent chain towards the plexus, by part name.
